description: Fix the Geocoder initialization defect in src/components/VayuLokLive.tsx: the component imports maps/marker/places via importLibrary but sources Geocoder from legacy.Geocoder and never imports the 'geocoding' library. Under the modern Maps JS loader (loading=async), google.maps.Geocoder is NOT populated until importLibrary('geocoding') runs, so in a real browser geocoder.current can be null and (a) reverse-geocoding on map click and (b) the autocomplete->geocoding search fallback silently do nothing / return 'unavailable'. Import the 'geocoding' library explicitly, construct Geocoder from it, stop depending on legacy.Geocoder, and make the geocoding tests production-like (do not rely on a pre-seeded google.maps.Geocoder that masks the missing import). Surface REQUEST_DENIED / error statuses in the search fallback instead of silently swallowing them. Do NOT regress the heatmap, the two-column layout, honest degradation, or the hero.
steps: In the map init effect in src/components/VayuLokLive.tsx, add `const geocodingLib = await imp('geocoding');` alongside the existing imp('maps')/imp('marker')/imp('places') calls (imp already swallows failures and returns null). Build the Geocoder constructor preferring the imported library: `Geocoder: (geocodingLib as { Geocoder?: ... })?.Geocoder || legacy.Geocoder` so a modern loader uses the dynamically imported library and only falls back to legacy for an older loader that already populated the namespace. Keep marker/places best-effort and non-blocking as they are now.

In the search runSearch fallback and anywhere else that lazily constructs a Geocoder from `window.google.maps.Geocoder`, ALSO prefer importLibrary('geocoding'): add a small async helper (mirroring ensurePlacesLibrary) e.g. ensureGeocoder() that does `const lib = await w.google.maps.importLibrary('geocoding'); return new lib.Geocoder()` when available, falling back to `new w.google.maps.Geocoder()` only if the import is unavailable. Use it so the fallback path does not depend on legacy.Geocoder being pre-populated.
Keep the geocoder stored in the existing geocoder.current ref and keep all existing call sites (map-click reverse geocode, search fallback) working unchanged in behavior when a Geocoder is available.

ERROR SURFACING (search fallback only): where the geocode callback currently maps non-OK statuses, keep ZERO_RESULTS -> 'no-results' but ensure REQUEST_DENIED / OVER_QUERY_LIMIT / UNKNOWN_ERROR / INVALID_REQUEST map to the existing 'unavailable' search status (which already renders a retry affordance) rather than being silently swallowed. Do NOT introduce red styling or new user-facing error chrome; reuse the existing .vl-live-search-status / .vl-live-search-status-error treatment (which is amber #6e4a18, no red). The map-click reverse-geocode path may keep its silent no-op on failure (it has no status UI), but do not make it crash.

HONEST DEGRADATION must stay intact: all geocoding-library imports happen ONLY on the existing keyed paths (map init with a key present; the search fallback which already runs only when MAPS_KEY is set). With no NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY there must still be no script, no map, no overlay, and zero network/import calls. Do not add any unconditional importLibrary call.

TESTS (src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx): Make the geocoding path production-like. (a) Extend the installGoogleMaps stub so google.maps.importLibrary('geocoding') returns { Geocoder: FakeGeocoder } AND REMOVE (or make opt-out) the top-level google.maps.Geocoder seeding for at least one test so that a test proves the component obtains its Geocoder via importLibrary('geocoding'), not via a pre-seeded namespace. Record on the MapsRecorder which libraries importLibrary was called with (push the name) and assert 'geocoding' is among them after map init. (b) Keep/añnade a test that the search autocomplete->geocoding FALLBACK still works when AutocompleteSuggestion is absent but importLibrary('geocoding') yields a Geocoder, and that a REQUEST_DENIED geocode status surfaces the 'unavailable' search status. (c) Keep the existing India-scoping, heatmap-on-user-action, left-card, number-only-pill, req-06 attribution, and honest-degradation tests green. Prefer behavioral assertions.

HEATMAP note (no code change required unless trivial): the AQI/PM2.5 overlay already points at the real Google Air Quality heatmapTiles API (UAQI_RED_GREEN / PM25_INDIGO_PERSIAN) at ~0.30 opacity, on user action, with the left-side result + legend. The user's heatmap asks are already satisfied EXCEPT 'verify real tile HTTP success', which is NOT verifiable in sandbox/CI because the browser Maps key is referrer-restricted to *.wecare.digital/* (live tiles only load on a deployed *.wecare.digital origin). Do NOT add a fake gradient / CSS heat colors / dummy heatmap. Record this limitation explicitly in findings; do not attempt to fake live-tile verification.

Do NOT touch the hero src/pages/vayulok/index.tsx (verify `git diff --stat src/pages/vayulok/index.tsx` is empty). Run `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npx vitest run src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx`, and `npm run test`; fix until all green.
acceptance_criteria: The map init effect calls importLibrary('geocoding') and constructs Geocoder preferring the imported 'geocoding' library, no longer depending solely on legacy.Geocoder; the search fallback likewise obtains its Geocoder via importLibrary('geocoding') when available.

A test proves the component obtains its Geocoder via importLibrary('geocoding') (i.e. passes without a pre-seeded google.maps.Geocoder on the namespace), and asserts 'geocoding' was among the imported libraries.

The autocomplete->geocoding search fallback still works via the imported Geocoder, and a REQUEST_DENIED geocode status surfaces the existing 'unavailable' search status (no longer silently swallowed).
Honest degradation holds: no key => no script, no map, no overlay, zero network/import calls.

No red introduced; no CSS targets .gm-style-cc / a[href*="google"] / img[alt="Google"]; heatmap wiring unchanged (real Google heatmapTiles, ~0.30 opacity, on user action) with the sandbox live-tile-verification limitation documented in findings.
npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm run test all pass; req-06 attribution guard and honest-degradation tests remain green.
findings: Fixed the Geocoder initialization defect in src/components/VayuLokLive.tsx and made the geocoding path production-like in src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx. CHANGES: (1) Map init effect now calls `const geocodingLib = await imp('geocoding');` alongside the existing imp('maps'/'marker'/'places') best-effort imports, and constructs Geocoder preferring the imported library: `Geocoder: (geocodingLib)?.Geocoder || legacy.Geocoder`. Under loading=async the raw google.maps.Geocoder is not populated until importLibrary('geocoding') runs, so this is what makes reverse-geocode-on-map-click and the search geocoding fallback actually get a Geocoder in a real browser. (2) Added an ensureGeocoder() useCallback helper mirroring ensurePlacesLibrary: it returns the cached geocoder.current if present, else does `await w.google.maps.importLibrary('geocoding')` and constructs from `lib.Geocoder` (falling back to `w.google.maps.Geocoder` only if the import is unavailable), caching into geocoder.current. (3) runSearch's autocomplete->geocoding fallback now awaits ensureGeocoder() instead of reading `window.google.maps.Geocoder` directly, so it no longer depends on a pre-populated legacy.Geocoder; added ensureGeocoder to the useCallback deps. (4) ERROR SURFACING: the geocode callback keeps ZERO_RESULTS -> 'no-results' but every other non-OK status (REQUEST_DENIED / OVER_QUERY_LIMIT / INVALID_REQUEST / UNKNOWN_ERROR) now maps to the existing 'unavailable' search status (amber .vl-live-search-status-error + Retry button, no red, no new chrome) rather than being silently swallowed. The map-click reverse-geocode path keeps its silent no-op on non-OK (it has no status UI) and does not crash. No unconditional importLibrary call was added: all geocoding imports happen only on the existing keyed paths (map init runs under `if(!MAPS_KEY) return;`, runSearch returns early when !MAPS_KEY), so honest degradation holds. PRODUCTION-LIKE TESTS: extended installGoogleMaps so (a) importLibrary records every requested library name on rec.importedLibraries, (b) importLibrary('geocoding') returns { Geocoder: FakeGeocoder }, (c) a new seedNamespaceGeocoder opt (default true) can suppress the raw-namespace google.maps.Geocoder seeding, and (d) a geocodeStatus opt lets FakeGeocoder.geocode invoke the callback with a chosen status (OK returns one India result; others return null). Added a 'geocoding library is imported and the geocoding search fallback works' describe with three tests: (i) with seedNamespaceGeocoder:false it asserts google.maps.Geocoder is undefined yet after map init rec.importedLibraries contains both 'geocoding' and 'maps' (proves the component gets its Geocoder via importLibrary, not a pre-seeded namespace); (ii) with AutocompleteSuggestion deleted and no namespace Geocoder, a search drives Geocoder.geocode with the India componentRestrictions and resolves a selectable Mumbai option, with 'geocoding' among imported libs; (iii) geocodeStatus:'REQUEST_DENIED' surfaces the .vl-live-search-status-error element with a Retry button. VERIFICATION (branch feat/vayulok-map-right-redesign): `npm run typecheck` clean; `npm run lint` 0 errors / 203 pre-existing warnings (eslint on the two changed files shows only pre-existing warnings at VayuLokLive.tsx:781 set-state-in-effect and several pre-existing warnings - none introduced by this change); `npx vitest run src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx` 22/22 pass; full `npm run test` 911 passed / 3 skipped / 0 fail (up from 908 by exactly the 3 new geocoding tests). `git diff --stat src/pages/vayulok/index.tsx` empty (hero unchanged). HEATMAP: no code change - the AQI/PM2.5 overlay already uses the REAL Google Air Quality heatmapTiles API (UAQI_RED_GREEN / PM25_INDIGO_PERSIAN) at ~0.30 opacity, on user action, with the left-side result + legend; no fake gradient / CSS heat colors / dummy heatmap was added. SANDBOX LIMITATION (explicit): the user's remaining heatmap ask - 'verify real tile HTTP success' - is NOT achievable in sandbox/CI because the browser Maps key is referrer-restricted to *.wecare.digital/* (live tiles only load on a deployed *.wecare.digital origin). This is likewise why the live map/geocoding cannot render in sandbox; verification was done via typecheck/lint/vitest + the production-like importLibrary('geocoding') tests + the honest-degradation test, NOT a live browser. The real-tile-render assertion was intentionally not faked.
